long_biography.plain_text:
The Taisun gantry crane became Brian Chang's defining contribution to offshore construction. At Yantai Raffles, he designed it to lift completed modules weighing up to 20,000 tonnes, enabling large rig sections to be built on land and joined at the dock. Its record-setting lifts helped the Chinese yard compete in semisubmersible construction.

Chang's approach grew from an electrical-engineering education in London and decades of building jack-up rigs, offshore structures and specialist vessels. He established Yantai Raffles on a former quarry site in 1994, developing a wide dry dock and surrounding facilities. After leaving the shipyard, he formed Calm Oceans to pursue patented platform designs for offshore oil and gas projects.
